# Compact trial retrieval: identical bodies explain the two missing search IDs

This resolves the unknown retrieval cause in [the compact trial report](5f97d574-30bd-4240-9001-c5b5445f087c.md). It preserves that trial's failed exact-ID gate and zero verified timed publication credits. Later diagnosis does not retroactively pass an earlier gate.

## Source behavior

At tb-tools `68ebea8b5c85d3dab6d483b023bd34e23bd509dc`, `searchKnowledge` sorts results, then computes a key from `kind`, `component`, sorted `paths`, and trimmed lowercase body text. If the key was already selected, it skips the record. The checked lines are [store.mjs:225–247](https://github.com/arschmitz/tb-tools/blob/68ebea8b5c85d3dab6d483b023bd34e23bd509dc/commands/knowledge/store.mjs#L225-L247); the key and skip are at lines 228–229, and line 244 saves only the selected ID.

This check is separate from [claim representative grouping](https://github.com/arschmitz/tb-tools/blob/68ebea8b5c85d3dab6d483b023bd34e23bd509dc/commands/knowledge/store.mjs#L187-L199). The three records below are evidence records. Each is its own representative and has no alias in the replay. [claims.mjs:23–40](https://github.com/arschmitz/tb-tools/blob/68ebea8b5c85d3dab6d483b023bd34e23bd509dc/commands/knowledge/claims.mjs#L23-L40) therefore does not join them. The later body check suppresses two IDs without exposing their provenance as aliases. `store.mjs` and `claims.mjs` are byte-identical at the original standalone reader revision `7299ecb34843bdbb409a72ed37992bbbad8d3f19`.

The retained result is [2a26567b5052](../records/2a26567b50525dad0c45d6505dfd01aecdc382c700dd78fb3fe9752573c8c43d.json). The omitted search IDs are [fac70e8869dd](../records/fac70e8869ddb0888df6899e687781901901777a8c5c2e7289897afbfe4dd58e.json) and [15985b183866](../records/15985b1838661df998d6fe42c0cee9466f6867978218491808a64666ef02f1e5.json). All three immutable originals remain stored and shared.

Their complete text, repository, kind, component, paths, source reference and contract ID are equal. The source reference pins [Test262 shell.js:55–111](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/js/src/tests/test262/shell.js#L55-L111). All three have no separate `source.revision` value; the revision is in that URL. Their producer hashes, review hashes and dates differ. Matching titles alone were not used as proof of equivalence.

## Replay and isolated preflight

A read-only replay on 2026-10-14 used the completed original trial cache. The database SHA-256 stayed `fdb5de8e1db6a537fa5cecceb922f57193fba04a91e10ecb5cd78ba6c691e1a3` before and after the replay. It found 86 exact stored records, 84 expected IDs in normal search, and matching bodies for all 86 records.

A fresh isolated store then parsed and imported the same frozen notes. From 01:07:44.460 to 01:07:44.693 UTC, it checked 86/86 exact stored records and 84 distinct searchable bodies. It again returned 84/86 exact expected search IDs. The total 232.733 ms comprises parsing, import and search for this batch, not source analysis or publication.

| Gate | Result |
|---|---:|
| Exact immutable records stored | 86/86 |
| Expected IDs returned by ordinary search | 84/86 |
| Records represented by checked equivalent bodies | 86/86 |
| Distinct bodies | 84 |

The isolated store had 86 pending learning rows because normal `put` creates them. No worker or service ran against it. The diagnostic invoked no sync, publication, product test, network API or console UI. It wrote nothing to the live store or shared checkout.

The replay receipt SHA-256 is `13b83587ae3351ca3197af5723b6eee06c800f7199f213e9a4bf0c1e60b8b386`. The fresh preflight receipt SHA-256 is `62c6fd93261242a9654a71c61159cc12e529fc2a19dd73609c3cf62e58fc7ce4`. These identify the preserved local diagnostic receipts; they are not runtime product-test results.

## Scope and remaining work

This is observed reader behavior and one frozen-batch diagnostic. Exact record preservation and ordinary search representation are different checks. The missing search aliases remain a retrieval limitation. No full-library ranking, embeddings, console UI, controlled publisher, or ninefold speed gain was validated. The older report's empty-path contract metadata limitation also remains. No source record or deliberate instruction was changed.
